newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Gold - Strong A$ hobbles producers.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Gold - Strong A$ hobbles producers.

text.p: Hobbled by a strong Australian dollar and lacklustre movements in the international gold price, Australian gold miners are showing little interest in selling into the current market, bullion dealers said on Friday.
This is expected to contribute to a further narrowing of the range in which gold is currently trading, the dealers said.
Gold producers typically buy and sell gold based on the proportions of their production that is not hedged or is uncommitted under forward sales contracts.
